title: Pokémon HeartGold/SoulSilver - Pokégear Radio: Buena's Password
description:
The peppy theme that plays when you tune into Buena's Password in Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver.

This song never fails to make me feel like grooving. Probably best suited for exciting bonus stages and the like.

Originally ported for Superfamicompo 3.
